As recurrence proceeds, state changes become increasingly concentrated on a small subset of tokens; attention-output differences are dominated by a sparse and stable subset of key columns; and KV residuals between adjacent loops become progressively more amenable to low-bit quantization. Building on these observations, we introduce FlashLoop, a training-free inference framework that reduces cross-loop redundancy through token-sparse updates, sparse attention, and KV-residual quantization. Across several Looped Transformers models, FlashLoop delivers lossless accuracy while achieving up to 1.64$\times$ end-to-end speedup and up to 6$\times$ KV-cache memory reduction, substantially improving the practicality of scaling Looped Transformers to greater computational depths and longer context.
papers.abstract_zh: 循环Transformer（Looped Transformers）作为一种通过重复使用共享Transformer块来增加计算深度的参数高效方法，引起了广泛关注。然而，它们相比传统Transformer的实际优势仍存在争议：每次额外的循环都会增加一次Transformer的传递，并需要缓存另一组KV状态，导致推理FLOPs和KV缓存内存随循环深度持续增长。这种开销在大循环计数和长上下文下尤为严重，阻碍了循环Transformer的参数效率转化为实际的推理效率。在本文中，我们发现循环引入的大部分额外计算和存储都是冗余的。随着循环的进行，状态变化日益集中在少数标记（token）子集上；注意力输出的差异主要由关键列的一个稀疏且稳定的子集决定；相邻循环之间的KV残差也变得越来越适合低比特量化。基于这些观察，我们提出了FlashLoop，这是一个无需训练的推理框架，通过标记稀疏更新、稀疏注意力机制和KV残差量化来减少跨循环冗余。在多个循环Transformer模型上，FlashLoop在保持无损精度的同时，实现了高达1.64倍的端到端加速和高达6倍的KV缓存内存缩减，显著提升了将循环Transformer扩展到更大计算深度和更长上下文的实用性。

mKiOAf37i0c.video_title: DexAgent: An Agentic Human2Sim2Robot Framework for Dexterous Manipulation with Self-Evolving Tool…

papers.title: DexAgent: An Agentic Human2Sim2Robot Framework for Dexterous Manipulation with Self-Evolving Tool Library (Sep 2026)
papers.abstract: Human videos offer a scalable source of demonstrations for dexterous robot manipulation. However, existing human-to-simulation-to-robot (Human2Sim2Robot) pipelines rely on predefined procedures that struggle to accommodate diverse object properties and interactions, particularly those involving articulated and deformable objects. We introduce DexAgent, an agentic Human2Sim2Robot framework that converts a single egocentric human video and a task prompt into physically grounded robot trajectories for policy training. It operates through four stages: semantic understanding of human videos, property-based simulation reconstruction, robot trajectory optimization, and robot data generation. At each stage, DexAgent adapts its approach to the task and object properties by selecting suitable skills from its tool library or developing new ones when needed. Property-specific verifiers assess stage outcomes for physical validity and task-specific requirements and provide feedback for refinement, preventing error propagation through the workflow. This adaptive, verification-guided process allows DexAgent to process diverse objects and long-horizon tasks. In the final stage, DexAgent varies object and robot states in simulation to generate diverse robot trajectories from a single human video, then retextures the rendered observations to facilitate sim-to-real transfer. Newly developed skills and verifiers are retained in its tool library, making it self-evolving to accumulate reusable capabilities. This reduces processing time as DexAgent encounters more human videos. Across eleven real-world tasks, policies trained with DexAgent-generated data achieve a 3.5x higher success rate than competing baselines. Project website: https://dexagent123.github.io/.
papers.abstract_zh: 人类视频为灵巧机器人操作提供了可扩展的演示来源。然而，现有的“人-仿真-机器人”（Human2Sim2Robot）流程依赖于预定义的程序，难以适应多样化的物体属性和交互，尤其是在涉及关节物体和可变形物体时。我们推出了 DexAgent，这是一个代理式的 Human2Sim2Robot 框架，它将一段第一人称视角的单个人类视频和任务提示转化为用于策略训练的物理基础机器人轨迹。它通过四个阶段运行：人类视频的语义理解、基于属性的仿真重建、机器人轨迹优化以及机器人数据生成。在每个阶段，DexAgent 通过从其工具库中选择合适的技能或在需要时开发新技能，来根据任务和物体属性调整其处理方法。属性特定的验证器会对阶段性成果的物理有效性和任务特定要求进行评估，并提供反馈以进行改进，从而防止错误在工作流中传播。这种自适应的、由验证引导的过程使 DexAgent 能够处理各种物体和长程任务。在最后阶段，DexAgent 在仿真中改变物体和机器人的状态，从而从单个人类视频生成多样化的机器人轨迹，然后对渲染的观测结果进行重纹理化，以促进从仿真到现实（sim-to-real）的迁移。新开发的技能和验证器会被保留在工具库中，使其能够自我进化以积累可复用的能力。随着 DexAgent 处理更多人类视频，这一过程减少了处理时间。在 11 项现实世界任务中，使用 DexAgent 生成数据训练的策略比对比基线实现了 3.5 倍的成功率提升。项目网站：https://dexagent123.github.io/。

tZ6ubS539Vk.video_title: Rufus-Air: An Open LLM Post-Training Recipe (Sep 2026)

papers.title: Rufus-Air: An Open LLM Post-Training Recipe (Sep 2026)
papers.abstract: Rufus-Air is an open and reproducible post-training recipe on GLM-4.5-Air-Base (106B-A12B), organized as a serial pipeline of eight stages: SFT, Reasoning RL, Coding RL, Instruction-Following RL, General Agent, Coding Agent, Search Agent, and RLHF. We document the data, reward design, infrastructure, stage order, and stagewise results needed to reproduce the recipe. Stages progress from basic to advanced capabilities and from hard, verifiable rewards to softer judge-based signals. Training builds on open-source components and public data, much of it used as released, without new human annotation or an in-house distillation teacher. Our main findings are that (i) diverse, high-quality SFT establishes a strong capability floor; (ii) difficulty filtering keeps RL prompts within a productive learning range; (iii) reward reliability provides a practical principle for ordering stages; and (iv) infrastructure and engineering choices are part of the recipe, not just an implementation detail. Rufus-Air improves over the official GLM-4.5-Air post-trained release and is competitive with similarly sized open models.
papers.abstract_zh: Rufus-Air 是一套基于 GLM-4.5-Air-Base (106B-A12B) 的开放且可复现的后训练方案，由八个阶段组成的串行流水线构成：SFT、推理 RL、编码 RL、指令遵循 RL、通用智能体、编码智能体、搜索智能体以及 RLHF。我们记录了复现该方案所需的数据、奖励设计、基础设施、阶段顺序及各阶段的结果。训练阶段从基础能力向高级能力演进，从硬性、可验证的奖励向基于模型评估的软性信号过渡。该训练基于开源组件和公共数据，大部分数据未经修改直接使用，且未进行大规模的人工标注或使用内部蒸馏模型。我们的主要发现包括：(i) 多样化、高质量的 SFT 构建了强大的能力基准；(ii) 难度过滤使 RL 提示保持在高效的学习区间内；(iii) 奖励的可靠性为阶段排序提供了实用的原则；(iv) 基础设施和工程方案是该配方的重要组成部分，而非单纯的实现细节。Rufus-Air 在性能上超越了官方发布的 GLM-4.5-Air 后训练版本，并与同等规模的开源模型具有竞争力。

wGjzJHLqHsM.video_title: EmbodiedSWE: Coding Agents for Long Horizon Dexterous Robotics (Sep 2026)

papers.title: EmbodiedSWE: Coding Agents for Long Horizon Dexterous Robotics (Sep 2026)
papers.abstract: We study coding agents for long-horizon, dexterous robotics and ask whether their solutions can provide scalable supervision for learning general robot policies. To test this, we develop EMBODIEDSWE-BENCH, a simulation benchmark for coding agents spanning contact-rich manipulation, deformable objects, and long-horizon tasks requiring up to half an hour of continuous interaction. We find that frontier coding agents can solve complex long-horizon tasks and transfer prior solutions across both tasks and embodiments. We also design supporting tools that help agents more effectively solve these tasks. However, the resulting solutions require substantial iterative interaction and are typically specialized to individual task instances. We therefore introduce EMBODIEDSWE-GEN, which expands a single solution from coding agent into large diverse trajectories for training a VLA. VLA performance improves with more generated demonstrations, and agent-aided diversification improves generalization to held-out task variations. We also show that a VLA finetuned solely on coding-agent-generated simulation demonstrations completes a long-horizon task on real robot. Together, our framework uses coding agents to solve complex robotics tasks and turn verified solutions into scalable supervision for robot policies.
papers.abstract_zh: 我们研究了用于长跨度、灵巧机器人的编程智能体，并探讨了它们的解决方案能否为学习通用机器人策略提供可扩展的监督。为验证这一点，我们开发了 EMBODIEDSWE-BENCH，这是一个针对编程智能体的模拟基准测试，涵盖了接触丰富的操作、可变形物体以及需要长达半小时连续交互的长跨度任务。我们发现，前沿编程智能体能够解决复杂的长跨度任务，并在不同任务和形态之间迁移先前的解决方案。我们还设计了辅助工具，帮助智能体更有效地解决这些任务。然而，由此产生的解决方案需要大量的迭代交互，且通常专门针对单个任务实例。因此，我们引入了 EMBODIEDSWE-GEN，它将编程智能体的单一解决方案扩展为用于训练 VLA 的大规模多样化轨迹。随着生成演示数量的增加，VLA 的性能得到提升，且智能体辅助的多样化有助于提高对未见任务变体的泛化能力。我们还展示了一个仅在编程智能体生成的模拟演示上进行微调的 VLA，能够在真实机器人上完成长跨度任务。总之，我们的框架利用编程智能体来解决复杂的机器人任务，并将验证过的解决方案转化为机器人策略的可扩展监督。

B43f3k4esAs.video_title: Rolling-WAM: World Action Models with Rolling Imagination (Sep 2026)

papers.title: Rolling-WAM: World Action Models with Rolling Imagination (Sep 2026)
papers.abstract: World Action Models (WAMs) couple action generation with future visual prediction for robotic manipulation. However, completing the joint video-action denoising process at each replanning cycle incurs substantial latency, delaying action updates and limiting closed-loop responsiveness. We present Rolling-WAM, a formulation that distributes joint denoising across successive replanning cycles. Our method maintains a sliding window of video-action chunks at staggered noise levels. At each step, a rolling noise schedule fully denoises the imminent action chunk for execution, while partially refining farther-future chunks. As the window advances with new camera observations, the retained future chunks continue their denoising process. This distributes the computational cost over time while carrying an evolving visual-action context across chunk boundaries. Evaluations on LIBERO, RoboTwin, and a real-world Unitree G1 humanoid show that Rolling-WAM achieves competitive manipulation performance. By removing the need to denoise the entire prediction horizon from scratch, it delivers a 4.5x steady-state replanning speedup over standard joint WAMs.
papers.abstract_zh: 世界动作模型（World Action Models, WAMs）将动作生成与未来的视觉预测相结合，用于机器人操作。然而，在每个重规划周期内完成联合视频-动作去噪过程会带来巨大的延迟，从而拖慢动作更新并限制闭环响应能力。我们提出了Rolling-WAM，这是一种将联合去噪任务分布在连续重规划周期中的方案。我们的方法维护了一个处于交错噪声水平的视频-动作片段滑动窗口。在每一步中，滚动噪声调度机制会完全去噪即将执行的动作片段，同时对更远未来的片段进行部分细化。随着窗口通过新的摄像头观测数据推进，保留的未来片段会继续其去噪过程。这种方法在随时间分配计算成本的同时，还在片段边界之间保留了不断演进的视觉-动作上下文。在LIBERO、RoboTwin和真实环境下的Unitree G1人形机器人上的评估表明，Rolling-WAM实现了具有竞争力的操作性能。通过消除从零开始去噪整个预测时域的需求，它相较于标准的联合WAM实现了4.5倍的稳态重规划速度提升。

papers.title: Simplex Diffusion Models (Sep 2026)
papers.abstract: Diffusion models have revolutionized generative modeling for continuous data through the gradual refinement of a belief state. This iterative refinement has not yet carried over to discrete diffusion models, which discard uncertainty at intermediate steps through categorical sampling (information collapse). We propose Simplex Diffusion Models (SDMs), a framework that lifts the diffusion process to the probability simplex to represent beliefs over categories. SDMs admit probability paths with closed-form reverse transitions and can be trained with a simple cross-entropy loss. Contrary to earlier proposals such as Dirichlet Flow Matching which requires integrating an ordinary differential equation, we introduce a DDIM-like sampler with a tunable level of stochasticity. Because SDMs operate on samples on the simplex, they can carry uncertainty across denoising steps, which mitigates information collapse. On OpenWebText, SDMs are competitive with strong Discrete Diffusion baselines, achieving $17.0$ GenPPL at $5.46$ unigram entropy in 64 sampling steps, close to real validation data. Even without Self-Conditioning (SC), SDMs outperform masked and uniform diffusion (with SC or predictor-corrector sampling) on code generation (TinyGSM, $T=0.1$; $49.0\%$ vs. $45.8\%$). Distilled down to 8 steps, SDMs solve $32.1\%$ of GSM8K problems, more than distilled Discrete Diffusion models with 128 steps ($21.4\%$).
papers.abstract_zh: 扩散模型通过对置信状态的逐步精炼，彻底改变了连续数据的生成建模。这种迭代精炼尚未应用于离散扩散模型，后者通过类别采样（信息坍塌）在中间步骤丢弃了不确定性。我们提出了单纯形扩散模型（Simplex Diffusion Models, SDMs），这是一种将扩散过程提升到概率单纯形（probability simplex）以表示类别置信度的框架。SDMs 允许具有闭式反向转移的概率路径，并可以使用简单的交叉熵损失进行训练。与之前需要积分常微分方程的方案（如 Dirichlet Flow Matching）不同，我们引入了一种具有可调节随机性的 DDIM 式采样器。由于 SDMs 在单纯形上的样本进行操作，它们可以在去噪步骤中保留不确定性，从而缓解了信息坍塌。在 OpenWebText 数据集上，SDMs 与强大的离散扩散基线模型具有竞争力，在 64 个采样步骤下达到了 17.0 的 GenPPL 和 5.46 的一元文法熵（unigram entropy），接近真实验证数据。即使在没有自条件（Self-Conditioning, SC）的情况下，SDMs 在代码生成任务（TinyGSM, T=0.1）上也优于掩码和均匀扩散模型（使用 SC 或预测器-校正器采样，49.0% 对 45.8%）。在蒸馏至 8 个步骤时，SDMs 解决了 32.1% 的 GSM8K 问题，超过了使用 128 个步骤的蒸馏离散扩散模型（21.4%）。

OXssVs8YU2c.video_title: Block Sparse Attention with Log-Linear Complexity (Sep 2026)

papers.title: Block Sparse Attention with Log-Linear Complexity (Sep 2026)
papers.abstract: Scaling language models to long contexts is limited by the quadratic cost of self-attention. Block sparse attention offers an efficient alternative, but selecting the retained blocks remains a bottleneck. Conventional block selection requires scoring all query-block pairs and therefore remains quadratic in sequence length. To address this issue, we propose PISA, a block-sparse attention mechanism that employs a pyramid Top-$K$ selection strategy. The main idea is to gradually narrow down the candidates across different levels, making it more efficient to find the most relevant keys. Specifically, we construct a coarse-to-fine hierarchy of keys and perform selection from the coarsest level. At each level, LogSumExp scoring is applied to a bounded candidate set to select candidates for the next finer level, continuing until the finest level is reached. Through pooling, we construct $O(\log N)$ levels of keys, yielding an overall complexity of $O(N\log N)$, where $N$ denotes the sequence length. We develop hardware-aware Triton kernels for both training and inference, fusing hierarchical routing and LogSumExp scoring without materializing the query-key score matrix. We further evaluate our method on language modeling tasks. Compared with the baseline, our method achieves comparable performance on benchmarks such as commonsense reasoning while delivering better results on retrieval tasks.
papers.abstract_zh: 将语言模型扩展至长上下文受到自注意力机制平方级计算成本的限制。块稀疏注意力（Block sparse attention）提供了一种高效的替代方案，但如何选择保留的块仍然是一个瓶颈。传统的块选择方法需要对所有查询-块对进行评分，因此在序列长度上仍然是平方级的。为了解决这一问题，我们提出了PISA，这是一种采用金字塔式Top-K选择策略的块稀疏注意力机制。其核心思想是跨不同层级逐步缩小候选范围，从而更高效地找到最相关的键。具体而言，我们构建了一个从粗到细的键层级结构，并从最粗层级开始进行选择。在每一层，我们对有限的候选集应用LogSumExp评分以选出进入下一更细层级的候选者，以此类推直至最细层级。通过池化操作，我们构建了O(log N)个键层级，使得整体复杂度达到O(N log N)，其中N表示序列长度。我们为训练和推理开发了硬件感知的Triton内核，在无需显式生成查询-键评分矩阵的情况下融合了层级路由和LogSumExp评分。我们进一步在语言建模任务上评估了该方法。与基准模型相比，我们的方法在常识推理等基准测试上取得了相当的性能，并在检索任务上表现出更好的结果。

i4K1QMoumY0.video_title: Just Ask Jev: Reinforcement Learning for Calibrated Decisions as a Zero-Shot Detector of AI…

papers.title: Just Ask Jev: Reinforcement Learning for Calibrated Decisions as a Zero-Shot Detector of AI Alignment Failures (Sep 2026)
papers.abstract: Detectors of alignment failures screen deployed language models and score alignment benchmarks. Most are generative judges that spend a decoding pass on every criterion, and classifiers that read token probabilities, such as Llama Guard, still score one fixed label per call. Jev, a model trained with reinforcement learning for calibrated decisions (RLCD), answers many typed questions about one input with calibrated probabilities in a single call. Whether it detects alignment failures has not been measured. We present RLCDAlignBench, which benchmarks Jev on ten alignment failures: sycophancy, jailbreaks, deception, prompt injection, hallucination, privacy violation, social bias, reward hacking, concealing uncertainty, and power seeking. It spans 44 benchmarks and five target models, labelled by each benchmark's scorer and, on two, by humans. Many of these failures are relational, defined against a reference, such as the user's belief or an injected instruction, that the response alone does not reveal. Our key idea is therefore to vary what Jev is asked separately from what it sees: the question's wording and answer type on one side, the fields of the input on the other. A single generic question reaches a median AUROC of 0.886 zero-shot and beats supervised baselines on most benchmarks. Question wording matters little, while context matters more, mostly through fields that encode the label. Jev matches the reference scorer's agreement with human labels, surfaces label defects in existing benchmarks, and costs 63x less than LLM-judge scorers. Code and data: https://github.com/sumleo/RLCDAlignBench.
papers.abstract_zh: 对齐失效检测器负责筛选已部署的语言模型并对对齐基准进行评分。大多数检测器是生成式评判者，对每个标准都要进行一次解码，而像 Llama Guard 这样读取标记概率的分类器，每次调用也只能给出一个固定的标签。Jev 是一个通过校准决策强化学习（RLCD）训练的模型，它可以在单次调用中通过校准后的概率，回答关于一个输入的多个类型化问题。目前尚未评估其是否能够检测对齐失效。我们提出了 RLCDAlignBench，用于在十种对齐失效类型上对 Jev 进行基准测试：谄媚、越狱、欺骗、提示注入、幻觉、隐私泄露、社会偏见、奖励黑客行为、隐藏不确定性和权力追求。该基准涵盖了 44 个基准测试和五个目标模型，由每个基准的评分器进行标记，其中两个基准还包含人工标注。许多此类失效是关系性的，需要根据参考标准（如用户的信念或注入的指令）来定义，而仅凭响应本身无法发现。因此，我们的核心思想是将 Jev 被询问的内容与它所看到的内容分开：一方面是问题的措辞和答案类型，另一方面是输入字段。单个通用问题在零样本（zero-shot）设置下达到了 0.886 的中位数 AUROC，并在大多数基准测试中优于监督基线模型。问题的措辞影响不大，而上下文的影响则更为显著，这主要通过编码标签的字段来实现。Jev 与参考评分器在人类标注上的一致性相当，能够发现现有基准测试中存在的标签缺陷，且成本比 LLM-judge 评分器低 63 倍。代码与数据：https://github.com/sumleo/RLCDAlignBench。

I1ZeiQbJXgc.video_title: TrackEverything: Long Horizon Dense Tracking via De-Duplicating 3D Scene Representations (Sep 2026)

papers.title: TrackEverything: Long Horizon Dense Tracking via De-Duplicating 3D Scene Representations (Sep 2026)
papers.abstract: Existing point tracking models face a fundamental tradeoff: they can either track a sparse set of query points over long horizons, or track all points across only short clips. We introduce TrackEverything, a 3D point tracker that breaks this trade-off by representing videos as persistent 3D scene tracks in world coordinates. Grounded in the insight that videos are 2D projections of an underlying 3D world, TrackEverything decouples model complexity from video duration, allowing it to scale with unique physical scene geometry instead. Our approach introduces three key innovations. First, we employ a voxelization-based de-duplication mechanism at sliding-window boundaries to merge co-located tracks, preventing repeated observations of the same surface from redundantly accumulating. Second, we decompose tracking into an endpoint refiner that predicts each point's destination and static-versus-dynamic classification, followed by a lightweight trajectory refiner that decodes dense trajectories exclusively for dynamic points. Third, we propose 3D WAFT, replacing memory-prohibitive 4D correlation volumes with efficient feature sampling in the scene cloud. To the best of our knowledge, TrackEverything is the first 3D tracker capable of tracking all visible points across videos exceeding 1000 frames within 40 GB of GPU memory. On TAPVid-3D, TrackEverything outperforms all open-source all-frame dense 3D trackers by more than 20% APD on short clips, while remaining competitive with state-of-the-art sparse trackers on long sequences, despite tracking far more points.
papers.abstract_zh: 现有的点跟踪模型面临一个根本性的权衡：它们要么在长序列中跟踪稀疏的点集，要么仅在短片段中跟踪所有点。我们引入了 TrackEverything，这是一个 3D 点跟踪器，它通过将视频表示为世界坐标系中的持久 3D 场景轨迹来打破这种权衡。基于“视频是底层 3D 世界的 2D 投影”这一洞察，TrackEverything 将模型复杂度与视频时长解耦，从而使其能够根据独特的物理场景几何结构进行扩展。我们的方法引入了三项关键创新。首先，我们在滑动窗口边界处采用基于体素化的去重机制来合并重合的轨迹，防止对同一表面的重复观测产生冗余积累。其次，我们将跟踪过程分解为一个端点细化器（用于预测每个点的终点及静态与动态分类），以及一个轻量级的轨迹细化器（仅为动态点解码密集轨迹）。第三，我们提出了 3D WAFT，用场景云中的高效特征采样取代了占用大量内存的 4D 相关体积。据我们所知，TrackEverything 是首个能够在 40 GB GPU 显存内，对超过 1000 帧的视频实现所有可见点跟踪的 3D 跟踪器。在 TAPVid-3D 基准测试中，TrackEverything 在短片段上的性能比所有开源的全帧密集 3D 跟踪器高出超过 20% 的 APD，同时在长序列上与最先进的稀疏跟踪器保持竞争优势，且跟踪的点数远多于后者。

papers.title: Generalization Dynamics of LM Pre-training (Sep 2026)
papers.abstract: People typically assume that LMs stably mature from pattern-matching parrots to generalizable intelligence during pre-training. We build a toy eval suite and show this mental model is wrong: throughout pre-training, LMs frequently and suddenly hop between parrot-like and intelligence-like computations. We call this mode-hopping. Across our suite, LMs suddenly latch onto memorized or in-context patterns instead of in-context learning, use System 1 instead of System 2 thinking, pick up what sounds true instead of what is true, fail at multi-hop persona QA, out-of-context reasoning, and emergent misalignment -- then just as suddenly revert and generalize. Mode-hopping is not explained by standard optimization dynamics: it is locally stable and cannot be fixed by checkpoint averaging. We instead think of it as a capacity allocation problem: in a capacity-bounded model, generalizable circuits must compete with the shallow ones learned early in training, and the data in each pre-training window may decide which circuits win. Our suite provides a new efficient lens on generalization. We demonstrate two concrete applications: (i) select intermediate pre-training checkpoints that strongly generalize reasoning and alignment, better than the final pre- or mid-training checkpoints, and (ii) select pre-training data that controls and stabilizes generalization dynamics.
papers.abstract_zh: 人们通常认为，语言模型（LM）在预训练过程中会稳定地从“模式匹配鹦鹉”演变为具备泛化能力的智能体。我们构建了一套小型评估工具集，结果显示这种心理模型是错误的：在整个预训练过程中，语言模型频繁且突然地在“鹦鹉式”计算与“智能式”计算之间切换。我们将此现象称为“模式跳变”（mode-hopping）。在我们的测试中，语言模型会突然偏向于记忆模式或上下文模式，而非进行上下文学习；使用系统1（直觉思维）而非系统2（逻辑思维）；选择听起来正确而非事实正确的内容；在多跳角色问答、语境外推理以及涌现出的对齐失效问题上表现糟糕——随后又会突然恢复并展现出泛化能力。模式跳变无法用标准的优化动力学来解释：它在局部是稳定的，且无法通过检查点平均（checkpoint averaging）来修复。我们将其视为一种容量分配问题：在容量受限的模型中，可泛化的回路必须与训练早期习得的浅层回路竞争，而每个预训练窗口中的数据可能会决定哪些回路胜出。我们的工具集为研究泛化提供了一个高效的新视角。我们展示了两个具体应用：（i）选择那些在推理和对齐能力上具有强泛化性的中间预训练检查点，其效果优于最终或中期的预训练检查点；（ii）选择能够控制并稳定泛化动力学的预训练数据。

gTWop3vXZ_w.video_title: MatToolBench: Benchmarking Multimodal Agents in Real-World Materials Science Workflows (Sep 2026)

papers.title: MatToolBench: Benchmarking Multimodal Agents in Real-World Materials Science Workflows (Sep 2026)
papers.abstract: Multimodal GUI agents have achieved impressive results on general software benchmarks, yet their ability to operate professional scientific software remains largely unexplored. In materials science, sparse domain-specific web data, specialized interfaces, and tacit workflow conventions create blind spots that general-purpose pretraining cannot readily bridge. We present MatToolBench, the first real-environment benchmark for evaluating multimodal GUI agents on professional materials science software, comprising 204 tasks across 10 tools in three modalities: GUI operation, OriginPro scripting, and code-based database queries, all executed inside a Windows 11 VM. Each task is decomposed into fine-grained sub-criteria by domain experts, enabling interpretable partial-credit scoring; the GUI component of our multi-level evaluation pipeline achieves an average F1 of 0.98. For OriginPro figure-generation tasks, we further conduct a human-LLM agreement study to validate the use of a multimodal judge for secondary aesthetic assessment. Our experiments show that strong performance on general benchmarks does not transfer to professional scientific workflows, and that this gap is not a visual-grounding problem alone: failures arise from domain-specific operational knowledge, sparse pretraining coverage of scientific software, weak cross-tool artifact handoff, and critical states exposed only visually. Even the best model reaches only 25% success rate on GUI tasks and 45% on code tasks. MatToolBench therefore serves as a challenging diagnostic benchmark and real-environment testbed for data-scarce, knowledge-intensive scientific workflows.
papers.abstract_zh: 多模态GUI智能体在通用软件基准测试中已经取得了令人瞩目的成果，但它们操作专业科学软件的能力仍未得到充分探索。在材料科学领域，稀缺的特定领域网页数据、专业化的操作界面以及隐性的工作流惯例，构成了通用预训练模型难以逾越的盲区。我们提出了MatToolBench，这是首个用于评估专业材料科学软件中多模态GUI智能体的真实环境基准测试，涵盖了在Windows 11虚拟机内运行的3种模态下的10款工具共204项任务，具体包括GUI操作、OriginPro脚本编写以及基于代码的数据库查询。每一项任务都由领域专家分解为细粒度的子准则，从而实现可解释的部分得分评估；我们多级评估流水线中的GUI组件达到了0.98的平均F1分数。针对OriginPro图表生成任务，我们进一步开展了人类与大语言模型（LLM）的一致性研究，以验证使用多模态评判模型进行二次审美评估的可行性。实验表明，在通用基准测试中的优异表现并不能迁移到专业的科学工作流中，且这种差距不仅仅是视觉定位问题：失败的原因源于特定领域的实操知识、科学软件在预训练数据中的稀缺覆盖、跨工具制品交接的薄弱，以及仅通过视觉呈现的关键状态。即使是性能最好的模型，在GUI任务上的成功率也仅为25%，在代码任务上仅为45%。因此，MatToolBench为数据稀缺、知识密集型的科学工作流提供了一个具有挑战性的诊断基准和真实环境测试平台。

papers.title: Agent Priors-guided Policy Learning (Sep 2026)
papers.abstract: Robots that learn from a few demonstrations often require two forms of generalization. Compositional generalization recombines skills to solve new tasks, and skill generalization lets the learned policy behind each skill work in new situations. The two depend on each other, yet information is lost between composition and the skills it calls. Where a skill works is determined by the structure its policy is trained with, while composition sees the skill only through a separate description, such as a name, an instruction, or a symbolic operator, that omits this structure. Our key idea is to use each policy's structural prior as part of the interface between composition and the skill. A structural prior states what a behavior depends on, for example that a grasp depends only on the gripper's pose relative to the object. Built into training, it shapes where the policy generalizes; stated in language, it tells composition where the policy applies. We instantiate this idea in Agent Priors-guided Policy Learning (APPL). A construction agent segments complete demonstrations into reusable skills, proposes several structural priors for each skill, and trains and verifies one policy per prior. A runtime agent then selects among these prior-specific policies and composes them toward new task goals using their interfaces. Across MetaWorld and long-horizon ManiSkill tasks, APPL improves out-of-distribution skill generalization and enables previously unseen skill compositions; ablating the interface information substantially reduces performance. These results support the use of training-time structural assumptions as a bridge between skill learning and skill composition.
papers.abstract_zh: 通过少量演示进行学习的机器人通常需要两种形式的泛化能力。组合泛化（Compositional generalization）通过重组技能来解决新任务，而技能泛化（Skill generalization）则使每个技能背后的学习策略能够在新的情境下工作。这两者相互依赖，但在组合及其所调用的技能之间往往会丢失信息。技能适用的范围由其策略训练时的结构决定，而组合层仅通过名称、指令或符号运算符等独立描述来感知技能，这些描述忽略了上述结构。我们的核心思想是将每种策略的“结构先验”（structural prior）作为组合与技能之间接口的一部分。结构先验定义了行为的依赖关系，例如抓取动作仅取决于夹爪相对于物体的位姿。将其融入训练过程，可以塑造策略的泛化范围；将其转化为语言描述，则能告知组合层该策略的适用场景。我们在“结构先验引导的策略学习”（Agent Priors-guided Policy Learning, APPL）中实现了这一想法。构建代理将完整演示分割为可重用的技能，为每个技能提出几种结构先验，并针对每个先验训练并验证一个策略；运行时代理则在这些针对特定先验的策略中进行选择，并利用它们的接口将它们组合以实现新的任务目标。在 MetaWorld 和长时程 ManiSkill 任务中的实验表明，APPL 提升了分布外（out-of-distribution）的技能泛化能力，并实现了以前从未见过的技能组合；剥离接口信息会显著降低性能。这些结果支持将训练时的结构假设作为技能学习与技能组合之间的桥梁。

tcKY92SWFZE.video_title: Despite Instructions: Frontier Agents Improvise Covert Channels at Test Time (Sep 2026)

papers.title: Despite Instructions: Frontier Agents Improvise Covert Channels at Test Time (Sep 2026)
papers.abstract: In security-sensitive applications, language-model agents are often required to coordinate without disclosing confidential information. Yet repeated interactions may also let ordinary messages acquire shared private meaning. We study a repeated game with pairs of models in which the sender model observes one of four secret states and selects one of four summaries of the same public report, while the receiver model tries to infer the secret state. We find that model pairs can learn to communicate the secret using only one bit of feedback indicating whether the receiver inferred it correctly. This learning occurs during inference with fixed parameters and no supplied codebook or encoding examples. The effect also persists when agents generate their own free-form updates in a simulated incident-response task. Across ten independent games, pairs of GPT-5.6 Sol agents reach 98.8% final accuracy, compared with 25% chance, despite explicit instructions prohibiting disclosure and a monitor that screens each message without access to the agents' interaction histories. The same interactions that help agents cooperate can therefore allow confidential information to pass through messages intended for legitimate coordination.
papers.abstract_zh: 在对安全性敏感的应用中，语言模型智能体通常需要在不泄露机密信息的情况下进行协作。然而，重复的交互可能会使普通消息获得共享的私有含义。我们研究了一种由模型对参与的重复博弈，其中发送者模型观察四种秘密状态之一，并从同一份公开报告中选择四种摘要之一，而接收者模型则尝试推断该秘密状态。我们发现，模型对可以通过仅包含“接收者是否推断正确”的一位反馈来学习如何交流秘密。这种学习发生在推理过程中，且模型参数固定，没有任何预设的码本或编码示例。当智能体在模拟的事件响应任务中生成自由形式的更新时，这种效应依然存在。在十次独立博弈中，GPT-5.6 Sol 智能体对达到了 98.8% 的最终准确率（机会率为 25%），尽管有明确禁止泄露的指令，且监控器在不访问智能体交互历史的情况下对每条消息进行了筛选。因此，那些帮助智能体协作的交互，同时也可能允许机密信息通过旨在进行合法协调的消息传递出去。

DFJ7VHyfbKY.video_title: Raven: The Harness of Harnesses for Composable Agentic Intelligence (Sep 2026)

papers.title: Raven: The Harness of Harnesses for Composable Agentic Intelligence (Sep 2026)
papers.abstract: As large language models advance, AI agents are moving beyond isolated, domain-specific tasks toward long-horizon, cross-domain workflows. This transition exposes two challenges: increasing harness complexity makes manual design difficult to scale, while tighter coupling to specific domains limits the generality of a single harness. The central question thus shifts from how to engineer a stronger harness for one domain to how to autonomously construct specialized harnesses, improve them through experience, and orchestrate them across domains. We introduce Raven, \emph{The Harness of Harnesses}, an open-source multi-agent ecosystem that automatically constructs and evolves modular harnesses for specific models and domains, treating each executable model--harness pair as a composable unit of intelligence. To support an \emph{All-Domain Collaboration Network}, its Host Agent decomposes goals, matches subtasks to specialized agents, coordinates execution dependencies, and integrates results, while a host archive and EverOS preserve experience across tasks and Skill Forge makes that experience available as reusable procedures. Our theory establishes sufficient conditions for such composition to expand reliable task coverage beyond that of the available individual agents under a shared resource budget. On complex and long-horizon tasks, Raven significantly outperforms the state-of-the-art agent systems, pushing the frontier of composable agentic intelligence.
papers.abstract_zh: 随着大语言模型的进步，AI智能体正从孤立的、特定领域的任务转向长周期、跨领域的工作流。这一转变带来了两个挑战：日益增加的测试框架（harness）复杂性使得手动设计难以扩展，而与特定领域过紧的耦合限制了单个框架的通用性。因此，核心问题已从“如何为一个领域设计更强大的框架”转变为“如何自主构建专业化框架，通过经验改进它们，并在跨领域任务中进行协同”。我们推出了Raven，即“框架之框架”（The Harness of Harnesses），这是一个开源的多智能体生态系统，能够为特定模型和领域自动构建并演进模块化框架，将每个可执行的“模型-框架”对视为一个可组合的智能单元。为了支持“全领域协作网络”，其宿主智能体（Host Agent）负责分解目标、将子任务匹配给专业智能体、协调执行依赖关系并整合结果；同时，宿主档案（Host Archive）和EverOS负责跨任务保存经验，而技能锻造（Skill Forge）则使这些经验能够以可复用的流程形式被调用。我们的理论确立了此类组合在共享资源预算下，将可靠的任务覆盖范围扩展至超越现有单个智能体能力的充分条件。在复杂和长周期的任务中，Raven的表现显著优于现有的最先进智能体系统，推动了可组合智能体智能的前沿发展。

HTrP2lji9NM.video_title: Decoding Looped Transformers Better for (Almost) Free (Oct 2026)

papers.title: Decoding Looped Transformers Better for (Almost) Free (Oct 2026)
papers.abstract: Looped Transformers achieve parameter efficiency by repeatedly executing a shared block across recurrent loops. Each loop yields an intermediate representation decodable for the same next token, yet standard decoding discards earlier states. Because earlier loops embody less computation, recurrence inherently supplies aligned weak-and-strong prediction pairs without auxiliary models or external training. We introduce LoopCD, a training-free contrastive decoding framework that guides token selection by contrasting the final prediction with an earlier recurrent pass, operating either in logit space with one extra output pass (LoopCD-Logits) or in hidden-state space with zero output overhead (LoopCD-Hidden). Across four looped Transformer families, LoopCD delivers substantial, consistent gains at full recurrent depth: LoopCD-Logits raises Ouro-2.6B-Thinking's AIME 2024 pass@1 from 61.88% to 73.33%, while LoopCD-Hidden lifts Huginn's HumanEval pass@1 from 22.56% to 31.71%. Crucially, these performance gains enable halving the number of recurrent loops while still matching or exceeding full-depth unguided baselines, reducing forward FLOPs by 22.5% to 48.2%. By transforming intermediate recurrent states into effective guidance signals, LoopCD achieves superior decoding quality while substantially reducing inference compute.
papers.abstract_zh: 循环Transformer通过在循环中重复执行共享模块来实现参数高效性。每一轮循环都会产生一个可解码出相同下一个标记的中间表征，然而标准解码会丢弃早期的状态。由于早期循环所包含的计算量较少，循环机制无需辅助模型或额外训练，天然地提供了对齐的弱-强预测对。我们引入了LoopCD，这是一个无需训练的对比解码框架，通过对比最终预测与早期循环的输出结果来引导标记选择，该框架可在对数几率空间（LoopCD-Logits，需额外一次输出）或隐藏状态空间（LoopCD-Hidden，零输出开销）中运行。在四个循环Transformer系列中，LoopCD在全循环深度下均带来了显著且一致的性能提升：LoopCD-Logits将Ouro-2.6B-Thinking的AIME 2024 pass@1从61.88%提升至73.33%，而LoopCD-Hidden将Huginn的HumanEval pass@1从22.56%提升至31.71%。至关重要的是，这些性能提升使得在循环次数减半的情况下，仍能达到或超过全深度无引导基线的水平，从而将前向FLOPs降低了22.5%至48.2%。通过将中间循环状态转化为有效的引导信号，LoopCD在显著降低推理计算量的同时，实现了卓越的解码质量。

uqa6gu3RUoY.video_title: You Only Edit Once: Incentivizing In-Context Capability of LLMs via Local Demonstration Refinement

papers.title: You Only Edit Once: Incentivizing In-Context Capability of LLMs via Local Demonstration Refinement (Sep 2026)
papers.abstract: In-context learning (ICL) is crucial for boosting the inference performance of large language models (LLMs). However, the effectiveness of ICL in LLMs is greatly influenced by the choice of demonstration sets. Exhaustive searches over these sets are combinatorial, and existing selectors often rely on relevance or likelihood proxies to implicitly assess ICL quality. Making repeated queries to the target LLM with these strategies can incur substantial costs. This work simplifies selection by framing it as a constrained local search problem and presents local demonstration editing (LDE). Starting with an initially retrieved set of demonstrations, LDE employs a single structured edit to explore its surrounding neighborhood while balancing performance gains with search costs. Technically, LDE is reduced to a policy search problem, for which we train a small LLM, referred to as Jev-LDE. This model as the System-1 modifies the retrieved demonstration set by performing actions such as \texttt{Keep}, \texttt{Delete}, or \texttt{Replace} elements, all within a framework of reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards. At test time, Jev-LDE executes a single edit of the retrieved demonstration set, followed by one inference from the target LLM, avoiding the need for iterative context scoring or subset searches. Across standard classification benchmarks, various target LLMs with Jev-LDE as the plug-and-play module consistently improve ICL performance, and Jev-LDE shows transferability to held-out benchmarks and models without retraining. These findings indicate that the LDE approach offers an efficient and adaptable method for harnessing the ICL capabilities of target LLMs.
papers.abstract_zh: 上下文学习（ICL）对于提升大语言模型（LLMs）的推理性能至关重要。然而，ICL 在 LLM 中的有效性很大程度上受到演示集选择的影响。对这些集合进行穷举搜索具有组合复杂性，且现有的选择器往往依赖相关性或似然代理来隐式评估 ICL 质量。使用这些策略对目标 LLM 进行重复查询会产生高昂的成本。本研究将选择过程简化为一个约束局部搜索问题，并提出了局部演示编辑（LDE）。LDE 从初始检索到的演示集出发，通过一次结构化编辑来探索其邻域，从而在性能提升与搜索成本之间取得平衡。从技术上讲，LDE 被简化为一个策略搜索问题，为此我们训练了一个名为 Jev-LDE 的小型 LLM。该模型作为“系统-1”，在可验证奖励的强化学习框架下，通过执行“保留”、“删除”或“替换”元素等动作来修改检索到的演示集。在测试时，Jev-LDE 对检索到的演示集执行单次编辑，随后由目标 LLM 进行一次推理，从而避免了迭代式的上下文评分或子集搜索。在各项标准分类基准测试中，将 Jev-LDE 作为即插即用模块的各种目标 LLM 均持续提升了 ICL 性能，且 Jev-LDE 在无需重新训练的情况下表现出了对未见基准测试和模型的迁移能力。这些研究结果表明，LDE 方法为利用目标 LLM 的 ICL 能力提供了一种高效且灵活的方案。

pQrtWYgwt2k.video_title: SketchSSM: Write to the Full State, Read from a Compact Sketch (Sep 2026)

papers.title: SketchSSM: Write to the Full State, Read from a Compact Sketch (Sep 2026)
papers.abstract: Hybrid-attention models replace most softmax attention layers with linear attention, reducing KV-cache growth and enabling larger decode batches where recurrent state access becomes a major bottleneck. ReplaySSM amortizes state updates by buffering keys and values, but each new query still requires a full-state read even though the state remains unchanged between state updates. We observe that low-rank state-weighted query approximation accurately preserves state-read outputs. Although future queries are unknown, the basis vectors used to approximate them can be fixed offline. Based on this observation, we introduce SketchSSM, which preserves full-state updates while approximating reads. At each state update, SketchSSM reads the full state once to precompute outputs for these basis vectors, storing them in a compact sketch. Each subsequent decode step combines the sketch vectors with query-dependent coefficients to reconstruct the output without a full-state read. Across four Mamba-2-, GDN-, and KDA-based models, SketchSSM reduces state-access traffic by approximately 10x while largely preserving average accuracy across four decode benchmarks and recall on four RULER retrieval tasks. On one NVIDIA B300, linear-attention kernel speedups over the standard vLLM baseline reach 7.78x, 5.22x, and 5.20x for Mamba-2, GDN, and KDA, respectively, with up to 2.64x higher decode throughput on Nemotron 3 Super.
papers.abstract_zh: 混合注意力模型将大多数 softmax 注意力层替换为线性注意力，从而减少了 KV 缓存的增长，并实现了更大的解码批处理量，但此时循环状态访问成为了主要的瓶颈。ReplaySSM 通过缓冲键（key）和值（value）来摊销状态更新，但即使状态在更新之间保持不变，每个新查询仍需进行全状态读取。我们观察到，低秩状态加权查询近似可以准确地保留状态读取的输出。尽管未来的查询是未知的，但用于近似它们的基向量可以在离线状态下固定。基于这一观察，我们提出了 SketchSSM，它在保留全状态更新的同时对读取过程进行近似。在每次状态更新时，SketchSSM 读取一次全状态，为这些基向量预计算输出，并将它们存储在一个紧凑的草图（sketch）中。随后的每个解码步骤通过将草图向量与查询相关的系数相结合，无需进行全状态读取即可重建输出。在基于 Mamba-2、GDN 和 KDA 的四种模型上，SketchSSM 将状态访问流量减少了约 10 倍，同时在四个解码基准测试中基本保持了平均准确率，并在四个 RULER 检索任务中保持了召回率。在单块 NVIDIA B300 上，相比标准 vLLM 基准，线性注意力内核在 Mamba-2、GDN 和 KDA 上的加速分别达到了 7.78 倍、5.22 倍和 5.20 倍，在 Nemotron 3 Super 上解码吞吐量提升高达 2.64 倍。

0T5CgPYJPw4.video_title: FuseReg: Regularizing Layer Fusion Mitigates the Reconstruction-Generation Gap in Representation…

papers.title: FuseReg: Regularizing Layer Fusion Mitigates the Reconstruction-Generation Gap in Representation Autoencoders (Sep 2026)
papers.abstract: Representation autoencoders (RAEs) reuse features from a pretrained visual encoder as reconstruction and diffusion latents, integrating strong visual representations into image generation. However, RAEs still need to decide which encoder layers form the shared latent space for the generator and pixel decoder. This choice involves a trade-off: shallower layers tend to preserve fine pixel details better, while deeper layers tend to yield better generation metrics. A fixed heuristic layer fusion therefore couples two stages that benefit from different information. We introduce FuseReg, which replaces heuristic feature selection with training over random subsets of encoder layers. We theoretically analyze the underlying mechanism: subset sampling preserves the full-layer latent mean in expectation while explicitly penalizing sensitivity to cross-layer disagreement. On ImageNet-256 with DINOv3-L, a single FuseReg decoder reconstructs from full, sparse, and single-layer fusions without retraining, achieving higher PSNR than decoders specialized to fixed fusions. This flexibility also benefits generation: decoder replacement alone reduces unguided gFID by 27% with an unchanged RAEv2 DiT-XL generator. Applying FuseReg to both stages also reduces unguided gFID by 29% on DiT-Base. The reconstruction and generation benefits also extend to other encoder families. FuseReg narrows the reconstruction-generation gap without additional training cost or architectural changes.
papers.abstract_zh: 表征自编码器（RAEs）通过复用预训练视觉编码器的特征作为重建和扩散潜变量，将强大的视觉表征整合到图像生成中。然而，RAEs 仍需决定哪些编码器层构成生成器和像素解码器的共享潜空间。这一选择涉及权衡：较浅层倾向于更好地保留像素细节，而较深层往往能带来更好的生成指标。因此，固定的启发式层融合将两个受不同信息影响的阶段耦合在一起。我们引入了 FuseReg，通过在随机的编码器层子集上进行训练，取代了启发式特征选择。我们从理论上分析了其潜在机制：子集采样在期望上保留了全层潜变量均值，同时显式地惩罚了对跨层不一致的敏感度。在 DINOv3-L 的 ImageNet-256 数据集上，单一的 FuseReg 解码器无需重新训练即可实现全层、稀疏层和单层融合的重建，其 PSNR 高于专门针对固定融合训练的解码器。这种灵活性也有利于生成任务：在 RAEv2 DiT-XL 生成器不变的情况下，仅替换解码器即可将无引导的 gFID 降低 27%。将 FuseReg 应用于两个阶段，在 DiT-Base 上也将无引导的 gFID 降低了 29%。这种重建和生成的优势也扩展到了其他编码器系列。FuseReg 在无需额外训练成本或架构变更的情况下，缩小了重建与生成之间的差距。

papers.title: Sharpening Tax in Post-Training (Oct 2026)
papers.abstract: An emerging hypothesis about reinforcement learning (RL) post-training of large language models (LLMs) is that it merely sharpens existing behaviors of a base model, improving single-shot accuracy at the cost of solution coverage. Although this trade-off has been observed in math and coding tasks, it need not extend to agentic tasks, where multi-turn tool use and interaction may require capabilities newly acquired during post-training. Our surprising finding is that pre-trained LLMs, equipped with a light inference harness, can serve as capable agents. Despite far lower accuracy (pass@1), they often surpass their post-trained counterparts in solution coverage (pass@K) given a sufficient test-time budget. We further analyze the underlying mechanism and show that post-training pushes tasks toward two extremes, always solved or never solved, and thereby improves sampling efficiency and consistency at the cost of solution coverage. To measure this cost, we propose Sharpening Tax, a diagnostic metric that quantifies the loss in test-time scalability after post-training. Across 14 base/post-trained model pairs from four families and three agentic benchmarks (42 cases in total), the tax is prevalent in most settings, can be estimated from a few rollouts, and correlates well with other metrics. Finally, we present posterior-tempered group sampling (PTGS), a simple plug-and-play Bayesian sampler that adapts the sampling temperature per prompt to its estimated difficulty. Applied during RL training in two agentic environments, PTGS pays a smaller tax than the fixed-temperature baseline, solving more tasks under repeated sampling while also improving single-shot accuracy.
papers.abstract_zh: 关于大语言模型（LLM）强化学习（RL）后训练的一个新兴假设是，它仅仅强化了基础模型现有的行为，以牺牲解决方案覆盖率为代价提高了单次（single-shot）准确率。尽管这种权衡在数学和编码任务中已被观察到，但它未必适用于智能体任务，因为在这些任务中，多轮工具使用和交互可能需要后训练期间新获得的各种能力。我们有一个令人惊讶的发现：配备轻量级推理工具的预训练LLM可以作为称职的智能体。尽管其单次准确率（pass@1）远低，但在有足够测试时间预算的情况下，它们的解决方案覆盖率（pass@K）往往超过了经过后训练的模型。我们进一步分析了其潜在机制，表明后训练将任务推向了“总是解决”或“从不解决”两个极端，从而以牺牲解决方案覆盖率为代价提高了采样效率和一致性。为了衡量这种代价，我们提出了“锐化税”（Sharpening Tax），这是一种诊断指标，用于量化后训练后测试时间可扩展性的损失。在来自四个模型家族和三个智能体基准测试的14对基础/后训练模型（共42个案例）中，这种“税”在大多数设置中普遍存在，可以通过少量采样进行估算，并与其他指标具有良好的相关性。最后，我们提出了后验调节组采样（PTGS），这是一种简单的即插即用贝叶斯采样器，可根据提示词的估计难度调整采样温度。在两个智能体环境的强化学习训练中应用后，与固定温度基线相比，PTGS支付的“税”更低，在重复采样下能解决更多任务，同时也提高了单次准确率。

nSS7_fOg-wI.video_title: Improving Test-Time Scaling with Adaptive Looped Transformers (Sep 2026)

papers.title: Improving Test-Time Scaling with Adaptive Looped Transformers (Sep 2026)
papers.abstract: Looped transformers have demonstrated promising parameter efficiency by reusing layers for latent computation. Prior studies compare looped and non-looped models at matched parameters or per-token FLOPs. However, to the best of our knowledge, whether looping improves test-time scaling as outputs grow longer remains underexplored. Through post-training looped transformers, we study the accuracy-compute slope, measured as the accuracy gain per doubling of test-time decoding FLOPs. We find that existing looped transformers often yield steeper slopes than their non-looped baseline, yet underperform it at matched compute. While fixed-depth looping spends extra iterations on every token, our analysis shows that many tokens do not benefit from extra iterations. We therefore propose TaH2, which enables the model to focus extra iterations on the tokens that benefit from looping. It jointly post-trains the backbone and an iteration decider through lookahead depth supervision, which uses online labels indicating whether further iteration improves the prediction. TaH2 improves both the efficiency and attainable accuracy of test-time scaling. On challenging AIME benchmarks, TaH2 improves the accuracy-compute slope by 53% (2.74 vs. 1.79) over the non-looped baseline, exceeding the baseline's peak accuracy by about 3.4 points at matched test-time compute. As the maximum iteration depth increases, existing looped models largely plateau, while TaH2's gain over the non-looped baseline continues to grow from +2.8 points at depth 2 to +3.9 points at depth 8. Our code is available at https://github.com/thu-nics/TaH.
papers.abstract_zh: 循环Transformer通过重复使用层进行潜在计算，展示了良好的参数效率。此前的研究在参数量或单Token FLOPs相当的情况下对循环模型和非循环模型进行了比较。然而，据我们所知，循环机制是否能随着输出长度增加而提升测试时缩放（test-time scaling）效果仍未得到充分探索。通过对循环Transformer进行训练后微调，我们研究了准确率-计算斜率，即测试时解码FLOPs每翻倍所带来的准确率增益。我们发现，现有的循环Transformer通常比非循环基线模型具有更陡峭的斜率，但在相同计算量下性能却不及基线模型。尽管固定深度的循环机制为每个Token都分配了额外的迭代，但我们的分析表明，许多Token并不能从额外迭代中获益。因此，我们提出了TaH2，使模型能够将额外的迭代集中在能从循环中受益的Token上。它通过超前深度监督（lookahead depth supervision）联合训练骨干网络和一个迭代决策器，该监督机制使用在线标签来指示进一步的迭代是否能改善预测。TaH2同时提升了测试时缩放的效率和可达到的准确率。在极具挑战性的AIME基准测试中，TaH2将准确率-计算斜率较非循环基线提升了53%（2.74 vs. 1.79），在相同的测试时计算量下，其准确率比基线模型的峰值高出约3.4个百分点。随着最大迭代深度的增加，现有循环模型的效果基本趋于平稳，而TaH2相对于非循环基线的增益则持续增长，从深度2时的+2.8个百分点增加到深度8时的+3.9个百分点。代码已开源至 https://github.com/thu-nics/TaH。

bNurmFALzCA.video_title: Write Back the $Δ$: Revisiting the Same Tokens with Fresh Representations (Sep 2026)

papers.title: Write Back the $Δ$: Revisiting the Same Tokens with Fresh Representations (Sep 2026)
papers.abstract: Transformers process information strictly forward through depth, preventing deeper computation from revisiting and refining earlier representations. To augment the standard forward pass, existing approaches either re-execute depth, incurring additional computation, or modify the residual stream using predefined directions, limiting their instance-level adaptation. Recently, inference-time feedback offers a direct mechanism for recycling endogenously produced computation by writing deeper residual states back to earlier layers, yet what should be fed back remains unclear. We argue that the depth increment Delta, capturing newly accumulated computation between two layers, provides a more effective, composable, and scalable feedback signal than the full state. Building on this observation, we introduce ReFlux, a learnable feedback graph that dynamically selects and composes increment-carrying routes. ReFlux supports synchronous feedback to the same token and streaming feedback to subsequent tokens. Extensive experiments across various models, corpora, and benchmarks show that synchronous ReFlux consistently reduces perplexity across ten language-modeling corpora, and improves accuracy by 2.1-2.3 points, with gains reaching 4.7 points on multi-hop reasoning. Streaming ReFlux further retains most of these gains while preserving the base model's 1x theoretical backbone FLOPs. These results establish ReFlux as an efficient paradigm for unlocking the latent computational potential of LLMs, allowing them to revisit the same tokens with fresh representations. Code implementation can be found at https://github.com/gooogleshanghai/reflux.
papers.abstract_zh: Transformer 模型的处理过程严格沿着深度方向前向进行，这阻碍了深层计算对早期表征的回顾与优化。为了增强标准的前向传递过程，现有方法要么通过重新执行深度计算来增加额外开销，要么使用预定义的方向修改残差流，从而限制了其在实例层面的自适应能力。近期，推理时反馈（inference-time feedback）提供了一种通过将深层残差状态写回早期层来循环利用内源性计算的直接机制，但应当反馈哪些信息尚不明确。我们认为，捕获两层之间新累积计算的深度增量 Delta，比完整状态能提供更有效、可组合且可扩展的反馈信号。基于这一发现，我们引入了 ReFlux，这是一种可学习的反馈图，能够动态选择并组合携带增量的路径。ReFlux 支持向同一 token 同步反馈，以及向后续 token 流式反馈。在各种模型、语料库和基准测试上的大量实验表明，同步 ReFlux 在十个语言建模语料库中一致降低了困惑度（perplexity），并将准确率提高了 2.1-2.3 个百分点，在多跳推理任务上的提升更是达到了 4.7 个百分点。流式 ReFlux 在保持基础模型 1 倍理论主干 FLOPs 的前提下，进一步保留了大部分性能增益。这些结果确立了 ReFlux 作为一种高效范式的地位，能够挖掘大语言模型（LLM）的潜在计算能力，使其能够用新的表征重新审视同一 token。代码实现请访问 https://github.com/gooogleshanghai/reflux。

UqDniRY8O-Q.video_title: T$^2$Mem: Learning Test-Time Memory for Robotics (Sep 2026)

papers.title: T$^2$Mem: Learning Test-Time Memory for Robotics (Sep 2026)
papers.abstract: Memory-dependent robotic manipulation requires policies to use information that is no longer available in the current observation. Retaining history alone is insufficient: memory must preserve information that supports future actions. One challenge is whether a memory-free foundation model can learn to retain and use historical information from action demonstrations alone, without external memory support. We introduce T$^2$Mem, a framework that develops this capability within a pretrained vision-language-action policy, without external reasoning models or memory-specific annotations. T$^2$Mem uses test-time training to encode observation history into compact fast weights through online self-supervised updates, avoiding repeated processing of the full history. An observation-grounded interface extracts vision-language information for memory formation and supplies retrieved context to the action expert. Action supervision shapes what the memory learns to retain and use, while alternating memory-policy learning gives each component a fixed counterpart during optimization. Across 16 RoboMME tasks, T$^2$Mem improves average success from 17.93% to 56.83% over the memory-free base policy and outperforms the recurrent-memory methods reported in the benchmark, while controlled profiling indicates at least 3x inference speedup over explicit methods. Project website: https://yzliu84.github.io/T2MEM-project/
papers.abstract_zh: 依赖记忆的机器人操作要求策略能够利用当前观测中不再可见的信息。仅保留历史信息是不够的：记忆必须能够保存支持未来行动的信息。一个挑战在于，无记忆的基础模型是否能在没有外部记忆支持的情况下，仅通过行动演示学习保留和使用历史信息。我们引入了T$^2$Mem，这是一个在预训练视觉-语言-行动策略内开发此能力的框架，且无需外部推理模型或专门的记忆标注。T$^2$Mem利用测试时训练（test-time training），通过在线自监督更新将观测历史编码为紧凑的快速权重（fast weights），从而避免了对完整历史的重复处理。一个基于观测的接口提取视觉-语言信息以构建记忆，并将检索到的上下文提供给行动专家。行动监督塑造了记忆学习保留和使用的内容，而交替进行的记忆-策略学习则在优化过程中为每个组件提供了一个固定的对应部分。在16项RoboMME任务中，T$^2$Mem将平均成功率从无记忆基础策略的17.93%提升至56.83%，优于基准测试中报道的循环记忆方法，且受控分析显示其推理速度比显式方法至少提升了3倍。项目网站：https://yzliu84.github.io/T2MEM-project/

2WkDHxB3PNc.video_title: Hard Vision, Easy Vision: What GPT-6 Astra Reveals Across Computer Vision (Sep 2026)

papers.title: Hard Vision, Easy Vision: What GPT-6 Astra Reveals Across Computer Vision (Sep 2026)
papers.abstract: Frontier general-purpose systems are rapidly expanding beyond visual understanding into capabilities traditionally handled by dedicated computer-vision models. As these capabilities expand, a central question for the computer-vision community is how far this reach extends, and what remains hard. We evaluate GPT-6 Astra alongside five frontier general-purpose AI systems across 34 capabilities and 55 benchmarks spanning nine areas of computer vision. We compare their performance with dedicated models and humans where suitable references are available. Astra demonstrates broad visual capability, with substantial gains over other frontier systems in visual and spatial reasoning and several forms of structured prediction. Across the state-of-the-art systems, a consistent pattern emerges. Capabilities involving semantic interpretation, reasoning, and object-centric prediction increasingly approach or reach available reference levels. In contrast, larger gaps remain when tasks require metric geometric accuracy, faithful reconstruction, temporally consistent dense prediction, or specialized fine-grained visual knowledge. Additional reasoning and specialist tools close selected gaps, but their benefits vary across capabilities. These results map a changing landscape of computer vision in which increasingly sophisticated visual tasks are accessible through a general-purpose interface, while precise and fidelity-sensitive perception remains an important frontier.
papers.abstract_zh: 前沿通用系统正迅速从视觉理解扩展到传统上由专用计算机视觉模型处理的功能领域。随着这些能力的扩展，计算机视觉社区面临的一个核心问题是：这些系统的能力边界究竟在哪里，以及哪些任务依然困难？我们评估了 GPT-6 Astra 以及其他五种前沿通用人工智能系统，涵盖了 9 个计算机视觉领域、34 项能力和 55 个基准测试。我们将它们的表现与专用模型以及在有合适参考基准时的人类表现进行了比较。Astra 展示了广泛的视觉能力，在视觉与空间推理以及多种形式的结构化预测方面，比其他前沿系统有显著提升。在这些最先进的系统中，出现了一个一致的模式：涉及语义解释、推理和以对象为中心的预测能力，正逐渐接近或达到现有的参考水平。相比之下，当任务要求度量几何精度、高保真重建、时间一致的密集预测或专门的细粒度视觉知识时，依然存在较大差距。额外的推理和专用工具可以弥补部分差距，但其益处在不同能力之间存在差异。这些结果描绘了计算机视觉正在改变的格局：日益复杂的视觉任务可以通过通用接口实现，而精确且对保真度敏感的感知仍是一个重要的前沿领域。

papers.title: Looped Diffusion Transformer (Sep 2026)
papers.abstract: Improving text-to-image models has traditionally relied on increasing model size or the number of denoising steps. In this work, we explore an alternative way to scale computation by repeatedly running shared Transformer blocks within each denoising step, effectively increasing computational depth while keeping the parameter count fixed. This looped computation enables iterative refinement of internal representations without explicit reasoning tokens. However, naive looping fails to consistently improve image quality. We trace this problem to weak supervision across intermediate loops and unregulated attention updates that progressively erode local information. To overcome these challenges, we propose Looped Diffusion Transformer (Looped-DiT), which combines deep supervision across intermediate loops with self-modulating attention to stabilize looped feature updates. Under matched-parameter and matched-compute settings, Looped-DiT consistently outperforms non-looped baselines. Notably, a 260M-parameter looped model can surpass a model 6.5x larger across multiple text-to-image benchmarks while requiring 4.9x lower inference compute. Beyond this performance gain, we find that looped computation can offer a more effective form of iterative computation for diffusion models, with increasing loop depth yielding larger gains than adding more denoising steps under a fixed inference budget. Furthermore, deeper loops can progressively correct mistakes made in earlier loops, exhibiting behaviors suggestive of latent reasoning. Together, these results show that looped computation offers a promising way to scale visual generation models.
papers.abstract_zh: 改进文生图模型传统上依赖于增加模型规模或去噪步数。在这项工作中，我们探索了一种通过在每个去噪步内重复运行共享Transformer块来扩展计算的替代方案，在保持参数量不变的同时有效增加了计算深度。这种循环计算能够在没有显式推理Token的情况下，实现内部表征的迭代细化。然而，简单的循环并不能稳定提升图像质量。我们将此问题归因于中间循环之间缺乏有效的监督，以及不受约束的注意力更新导致局部信息逐渐丧失。为了克服这些挑战，我们提出了Looped Diffusion Transformer（Looped-DiT），它结合了跨中间循环的深度监督与自调节注意力机制，以稳定循环特征更新。在参数量和计算量匹配的设置下，Looped-DiT的表现持续优于非循环基线模型。值得注意的是，一个260M参数的循环模型可以在多个文生图基准测试中超越规模大6.5倍的模型，同时推理计算量降低了4.9倍。除了性能提升外，我们发现循环计算可以为扩散模型提供一种更有效的迭代计算形式，在固定的推理预算下，增加循环深度比增加去噪步数能带来更大的增益。此外，更深的循环可以逐步修正早期循环中产生的错误，表现出暗示潜在推理的行为。总之，这些结果表明，循环计算为扩展视觉生成模型提供了一种有前景的途径。

V_4wBjF2rCo.video_title: ScholarCatalyst: A Benchmark for Retrieving Papers That Inspire New Research (Oct 2026)

papers.title: ScholarCatalyst: A Benchmark for Retrieving Papers That Inspire New Research (Oct 2026)
papers.abstract: What makes great scientists great? Even as AI systems start to make progress on open problems, scientists remain far ahead of them at sensing which prior idea, buried in an ever-growing archive of research, a new problem needs. To study this skill, we draw on researchers who know firsthand which earlier work advanced their completed projects, with papers serving as pointers to the ideas within. Using our automated pipeline that makes author annotation scalable, we build ScholarCatalyst by having 184 lead authors of 207 recent computer science papers label which candidates did or could have advanced their project, each with a detailed rationale. We introduce a retrieval task with author-provided judgments: given an initial research question, retrieve these papers from only the literature available when the project began. Agentic search does no better than embedding retrieval (0.42 vs. 0.48 Recall@20) despite calling that same retriever as a tool. Even an agent built on Claude Fable 5.1, which may have seen the completed papers during training, reaches only 0.51 R@20. These results highlight the need for new training recipes that equip models with expert intuition for searching broad corpora. We envision ScholarCatalyst as a step toward scientific agents that can take a half-formed idea and point to the prior research it needs.
papers.abstract_zh: 是什么造就了伟大的科学家？尽管人工智能系统已开始在开放性问题上取得进展，但在感知浩如烟海的研究文献中哪项过往观点对解决新问题至关重要时，科学家们依然远超AI。为了研究这一能力，我们求助于那些最了解哪些早期研究推动了其项目进展的研究者，并将论文作为指向内部思想的索引。利用能够实现作者标注规模化的自动化流程，我们构建了 ScholarCatalyst，邀请 184 位近期计算机科学论文的第一作者对哪些候选文献曾推动或本可推动其项目进行标注，并附带详细理由。我们引入了一项基于作者判断的检索任务：给定一个初始研究问题，仅从项目开始时已有的文献中检索这些论文。尽管智能体搜索调用了与嵌入检索相同的检索器作为工具，但其表现并不优于嵌入检索（Recall@20 分别为 0.42 对 0.48）。即便是构建于 Claude Fable 5.1 之上的智能体（该模型在训练期间可能已见过这些已完成的论文），其 R@20 也仅达到 0.51。这些结果凸显了开发新训练方案的必要性，即赋予模型在庞大语料库中进行搜索的专家直觉。我们设想 ScholarCatalyst 是迈向科学智能体的一步，未来这些智能体能够承接一个半成型的想法，并精准指出其所需要的先期研究。

mWHnjiKX18E.video_title: Harness Learning Enables Generalizable Test-Time Adaptation (Sep 2026)

papers.title: Harness Learning Enables Generalizable Test-Time Adaptation (Sep 2026)
papers.abstract: A language-model agent is jointly defined by its model and its harness, the executable program that organizes model calls, tool use, and information flow. Because different tasks call for different ways of organizing these operations, the harness needs to be adapted using feedback from the task at hand. We introduce harness learning, which trains a proposer model to revise a solver's harness using execution feedback. We formulate this process as meta-learning over executable programs, with harness revisions playing the role of weight updates in gradient-based adaptation. We train the proposer with reinforcement learning, using the task performance of revised harnesses as the reward. At test time, the proposer uses feedback from successive executions on a new task to refine the harness, without performing any parameter-space update. Experiments on reasoning and multi-hop question answering show that harness learning improves revision quality and that the ability to adapt at test time transfers to unseen tasks. Policies trained on individual revisions can continue improving harnesses over multiple rounds, while the benefits of training on revision sequences vary across settings. These findings suggest a path towards continually learning agents that turn accumulated experience into generalizable improvements.
papers.abstract_zh: 语言模型智能体由其模型及其框架（harness）共同定义，后者是组织模型调用、工具使用和信息流的可执行程序。由于不同任务需要不同的操作组织方式，因此需要利用手头任务的反馈来调整该框架。我们引入了“框架学习”（harness learning），即训练一个提议者（proposer）模型，利用执行反馈来修正求解器（solver）的框架。我们将这一过程表述为对可执行程序的元学习，其中框架的修正起到了基于梯度的适应中权重更新的作用。我们使用强化学习训练提议者，并将修正后框架的任务表现作为奖励。在测试时，提议者利用对新任务连续执行的反馈来优化框架，而无需执行任何参数空间的更新。在推理和多跳问答任务上的实验表明，框架学习提高了修正质量，并且在测试时的适应能力可以迁移到未见过的任务中。在单个修正上训练的策略可以在多轮迭代中持续改进框架，而在修正序列上进行训练所带来的收益则因设置不同而异。这些发现为通向能够将积累的经验转化为可泛化改进的持续学习智能体指明了方向。

AqqJHAW8Zvo.video_title: VISTA: A Visual Harness for Reasoning in an Interactive World (Oct 2026)

papers.title: VISTA: A Visual Harness for Reasoning in an Interactive World (Oct 2026)
papers.abstract: We show that multimodal models possess strong reasoning abilities and that an appropriate harness can unlock their potential to solve tasks across diverse interactive environments. We introduce VISTA, a visual harness that gives a general-purpose multimodal model long-horizon vision. VISTA allows the model to directly perceive the environment through visual observations and maintains a lossless visual memory that preserves past observations in their original form. The model can actively retrieve these observations and reorganize its visual input as it reasons. On ARC-AGI-3, VISTA improves Claude Opus 5.0's Relative Human Action Efficiency score from 40.68 to a perfect 100.00, with the model completing all 25 public games using 57.4% fewer actions than first-time human participants. VISTA's simple design also allows it to extend naturally to diverse visual environments with minimal adaptation. Across three additional benchmarks covering a diverse range of visual games and puzzles, it substantially outperforms baselines using the same underlying model with minimal harnesses. Our results highlight VISTA's potential as a general-purpose visual harness for advancing multimodal agents in complex visual environments.
papers.abstract_zh: 我们证明了多模态模型具备强大的推理能力，而适当的工具框架可以释放其在各类交互式环境中解决任务的潜力。我们推出了 VISTA，这是一个为通用多模态模型提供长程视觉能力的视觉框架。VISTA 允许模型通过视觉观察直接感知环境，并维护一种无损的视觉记忆，以原始形式保存过去的观察结果。模型可以在推理过程中主动检索这些观察结果并重组其视觉输入。在 ARC-AGI-3 测试中，VISTA 将 Claude Opus 5.0 的相对人类行动效率（Relative Human Action Efficiency）得分从 40.68 提升到了满分 100.00，模型仅用初次参与的人类玩家 42.6% 的动作数量就完成了全部 25 个公开游戏。VISTA 简洁的设计使其能够以极小的适配成本自然地扩展到多种视觉环境中。在涵盖各类视觉游戏和谜题的另外三个基准测试中，与使用相同基础模型但配合极简框架的基线相比，VISTA 的表现大幅领先。我们的研究结果凸显了 VISTA 作为一种通用视觉框架，在推动多模态智能体应对复杂视觉环境方面的潜力。

2FP1SUq1qPQ.video_title: Finetuning with Sampling: SFT Learns Better Than You Think (Oct 2026)

papers.title: Finetuning with Sampling: SFT Learns Better Than You Think (Oct 2026)
papers.abstract: Introducing new capabilities to frontier models has long been the goal of posttraining, which predominantly employs supervised finetuning (SFT) and reinforcement learning (RL) to this end. Conventional wisdom dictates that RL enables strong generalization on new tasks without losing existing capabilities, while SFT is prone to weak generalization and catastrophic forgetting. At the same time, SFT can learn from off-policy expert data, whereas RL must rely on a model's ability to find successful trajectories with repeated sampling. In our work, we seek to leverage the strength of on-policy learning while utilizing the privileged information contained in off-policy data. However, rather than modifying the learning objective to accommodate this data, we instead tailor the data distribution to better suit the learner. We introduce a Markov chain Monte Carlo (MCMC) sampling algorithm that progressively transforms off-policy traces to be more on-policy given a reference model for finetuning. Across tasks like scientific skill acquisition, mathematical reasoning, and open-ended expertise, our sampling algorithm enables SFT to rival prevailing posttraining techniques, often generalizing better and forgetting less than strong on-policy baselines. In addition, the resulting finetuned models exhibit strong distributional performance and are capable of learning beyond sharpening the base model distribution. At a higher level, our approach presents sampling as a model-native operator that shapes data for learnability, offering broader utility as a general-purpose primitive throughout the posttraining stack.
papers.abstract_zh: 为前沿模型引入新能力一直是后训练（posttraining）的目标，该领域目前主要采用监督微调（SFT）和强化学习（RL）来实现这一目的。传统观点认为，RL 能够在不丧失现有能力的情况下实现对新任务的强泛化，而 SFT 则容易出现泛化能力弱和灾难性遗忘的问题。与此同时，SFT 可以从离线（off-policy）专家数据中学习，而 RL 必须依赖模型通过重复采样寻找成功轨迹的能力。在我们的工作中，我们试图在利用离线数据中包含的特权信息的同时，发挥在线（on-policy）学习的优势。然而，我们并未通过修改学习目标来适应这些数据，而是通过调整数据分布使其更适合学习者。我们引入了一种马尔可夫链蒙特卡罗（MCMC）采样算法，该算法在给定参考模型进行微调的情况下，将离线轨迹逐步转换为更符合在线分布的轨迹。在科学技能习得、数学推理和开放式专业知识等任务中，我们的采样算法使 SFT 能够媲美当前主流的后训练技术，且通常比强在线基准模型具有更好的泛化能力和更少的遗忘。此外，由此产生的微调模型表现出强大的分布性能，并具备超越简单强化基础模型分布的学习能力。从更高层面来看，我们的方法将采样视为一种模型原生操作符，通过塑造数据来提升可学习性，并作为一种通用原语在整个后训练技术栈中提供了更广泛的用途。

2j6bs_SAk0s.video_title: How Jev Works: The AI Model That Can't Write, and What RLCD Is

papers.abstract: When language models (LMs) are trained via reinforcement learning (RL) to generate natural language "reasoning chains", their performance improves on a variety of difficult question answering tasks. Today, almost all successful applications of RL for reasoning use binary reward functions that evaluate the correctness of LM outputs. Because such reward functions do not penalize guessing or low-confidence outputs, they often have the unintended side-effect of degrading calibration and increasing the rate at which LMs generate incorrect responses (or "hallucinate") in other problem domains. This paper describes RLCR (Reinforcement Learning with Calibration Rewards), an approach to training reasoning models that jointly improves accuracy and calibrated confidence estimation. During RLCR, LMs generate both predictions and numerical confidence estimates after reasoning. They are trained to optimize a reward function that augments a binary correctness score with a Brier score -- a scoring rule for confidence estimates that incentivizes calibrated prediction. We first prove that this reward function (or any reward function that uses a bounded, proper scoring rule) yields models whose predictions are both accurate and well-calibrated. We next show that across diverse datasets, RLCR substantially improves calibration with no loss in accuracy, on both in-domain and out-of-domain evaluations -- outperforming both ordinary RL training and classifiers trained to assign post-hoc confidence scores. While ordinary RL hurts calibration, RLCR improves it. Finally, we demonstrate that verbalized confidence can be leveraged at test time to improve accuracy and calibration via confidence-weighted scaling methods. Our results show that explicitly optimizing for calibration can produce more generally reliable reasoning models. Code, models, and further info is available at https://rl-calibration.github.io/.
papers.abstract_zh: 当语言模型（LM）通过强化学习（RL）进行训练以生成自然语言“推理链”时，它们在各种困难问答任务上的表现都会得到提升。目前，几乎所有利用强化学习进行推理的成功应用都使用评估语言模型输出正确性的二元奖励函数。由于这些奖励函数不会惩罚猜测或低置信度的输出，它们往往会产生意想不到的副作用，即降低校准度，并增加语言模型在其他问题领域生成错误响应（或“幻觉”）的频率。本文介绍了 RLCR（Reinforcement Learning with Calibration Rewards，带校准奖励的强化学习），这是一种旨在同时提高准确性和校准置信度估计的推理模型训练方法。在 RLCR 过程中，语言模型在推理后会同时生成预测结果和数值置信度估计。它们通过优化一个奖励函数进行训练，该函数将二元正确性得分与 Brier 分数（一种激励校准预测的置信度估计评分规则）相结合。我们首先证明，该奖励函数（或任何使用有界、恰当评分规则的奖励函数）能够产生既准确又校准良好的模型。接下来，我们展示了在多样化的数据集上，无论是在域内评估还是域外评估，RLCR 都能在不损失准确性的前提下显著改善校准度，其表现优于普通的强化学习训练以及为分配事后置信度得分而训练的分类器。普通强化学习会损害校准，而 RLCR 则能改善校准。最后，我们证明了在测试时可以通过置信度加权缩放方法利用口头表达的置信度来提高准确性和校准度。我们的结果表明，显式地针对校准进行优化可以产生更具普遍可靠性的推理模型。代码、模型及更多信息请访问 https://rl-calibration.github.io/。

papers.abstract: Jev is a commercial System One model from TypeSafe AI that does not generate text: given a state and typed questions, it returns a choice from fixed options, a position on a rubric, or the probability that a statement is true, with probabilities the vendor describes as calibrated. Such models target small decisions in information access pipelines, such as routing queries, checking grounding, moderating content, or rating against a rubric. We evaluate Jev (jev-1.13.0) zero-shot on 37 datasets spanning classification, routing, natural language inference, reading comprehension, commonsense reasoning, moderation, legal clause analysis and rubric scoring, with one frozen template per dataset and full evaluation splits: 346,009 requests for under USD 10. For reference, we score Qwen3.8-27B and Gemma-4-E4B on identical requests via their exact next-token probabilities over the options. Jev reaches 95-99% accuracy on IMDB, SST-2, HellaSwag and ARC and 86.7% on Belebele across 122 languages. It beats Qwen on 27 of 37 datasets, with none of Qwen's nine leads outside the bootstrap intervals, and Gemma on all 37. All three models degrade on low-resource languages, fine-grained or noisy labels, and rubric-based quality judgments. Jev's choice probabilities are well calibrated and support selective prediction. Binary probabilities rank well but are poorly placed relative to a fixed 0.5 threshold; thresholds tuned on training data raise micro-F1 on UNFAIR-ToS from 0.50 to 0.75. Jev answers MMLU's calculation-heavy questions more accurately than other MMLU questions (94% vs. 91%), whereas both open models, and all three on C-Eval, find them harder. Rotating the options leaves Jev's accuracy unchanged and withholding the question drops it to near chance, ruling out shallow memorization but not memorized question-answer pairs. We release the code, harness and all raw responses.
papers.abstract_zh: Jev 是来自 TypeSafe AI 的一款商用 System One 模型，它不生成文本：给定状态和类型化问题，它会从固定选项中返回一个选择、量规上的位置，或者陈述为真的概率，供应商称这些概率是经过校准的。此类模型针对信息访问流程中的小型决策，例如查询路由、检查基础事实、内容审核或根据量规进行评分。我们在涵盖分类、路由、自然语言推理、阅读理解、常识推理、审核、法律条款分析和量规评分的 37 个数据集上对 Jev (jev-1.13.0) 进行了零样本评估，每个数据集使用一个固定的模板，并使用完整的评估拆分：共 346,009 次请求，成本低于 10 美元。作为参考，我们通过 Qwen3.8-27B 和 Gemma-4-E4B 在相同请求上的精确下一词概率对选项进行评分。Jev 在 IMDB、SST-2、HellaSwag 和 ARC 上达到了 95-99% 的准确率，在 122 种语言的 Belebele 上达到了 86.7% 的准确率。它在 37 个数据集中的 27 个上优于 Qwen，而 Qwen 的 9 个领先项均未超出引导置信区间，且在所有 37 个数据集上均优于 Gemma。这三个模型在低资源语言、细粒度或噪声标签以及基于量规的质量判断上表现均有所下降。Jev 的选择概率校准良好，并支持选择性预测。二元概率排名表现良好，但相对于 0.5 的固定阈值定位不佳；在训练数据上调整后的阈值将 UNFAIR-ToS 上的微观 F1 从 0.50 提高到了 0.75。Jev 在回答 MMLU 中计算密集型问题时比其他 MMLU 问题更准确（94% 对 91%），而两个开源模型以及所有三个模型在 C-Eval 上都发现这些问题更难。轮换选项不会改变 Jev 的准确率，而不提供问题则会导致准确率降至接近随机水平，这排除了浅层记忆的可能性，但不能排除记忆的问题-答案对。我们已发布代码、测试工具和所有原始响应。

papers.abstract: LLM-as-a-judge scales evaluation, but reasoning judges are slow and costly. We study JEV-as-a-Judge: evaluation with JEV, a decision-only judge that returns label probabilities instead of text, and whose confidence decides whether to accept its verdict or escalate to a reasoning judge. Against sixteen generative and reward-model judges, with blinded human adjudication, JEV comes within three points of GPT-6 wherever a verdict can be read off the text, at 0.36% of its fee and a 0.15-second median latency, and falls behind where the verdict must be derived, as in math, code, and logic. Its confidence marks this boundary. With a threshold frozen in advance, accepting confident verdicts and escalating the rest is 0.9 points more accurate than GPT-6 on 1,610 held-out pairs at 41% of its fee, and in a pre-specified live test on two new workloads the cascade matches GPT-6's accuracy exactly. Confidence routing weakens on style-adversarial pairs and reference-free prose; we close with a simple recipe for validating thresholds locally.
papers.abstract_zh: 以大语言模型作为裁判（LLM-as-a-judge）虽能扩展评估规模，但推理型裁判速度慢且成本高。我们研究了 JEV-as-a-Judge：一种使用 JEV（仅输出决策的裁判）进行的评估方法。JEV 返回标签概率而非文本，并根据其置信度决定是采纳结论还是升级调用推理型裁判。通过与十六个生成式和奖励模型裁判进行盲测和人工仲裁对比，在能够从文本直接得出结论的场景下，JEV 的表现与 GPT-4o 差距在 3 个百分点以内，且成本仅为其 0.36%，中位延迟仅为 0.15 秒；而在需要推导结论的数学、代码和逻辑任务中，其表现则有所落后。JEV 的置信度清晰地标记了这一边界。在预设阈值的情况下，通过采纳高置信度结论并对剩余部分进行升级，该级联方法在 1,610 对留出测试集上的准确率比 GPT-4o 高出 0.9 个百分点，且成本仅为其 41%；在针对两个新工作负载的预设实测中，该级联方法的准确率与 GPT-4o 完全持平。置信度路由在风格对抗样本和无参考文本生成中表现有所下降；我们最后提供了一个在本地验证阈值的简便方案。

papers.abstract: Jev is a fast, low-cost decision model that answers natural-language questions with choices, binary judgments, and scores. As its public ecosystem grows rapidly, it remains unclear how Jev is used across applications and how public attention relates to project distribution. To answer these questions, we conduct a large-scale, data-driven analysis of 2,170 publicly available Jev projects collected from GitHub as of September 22, 2026. We find rapid early growth in Jev's public ecosystem, with both new projects and integration into existing repositories. Across diverse domains, projects use Jev for multiple decision purposes and combine its interfaces. Attribute judgment and scoring are widely used, while the use of action selection, content filtering, and model and tool selection varies across domains. These patterns suggest that Jev serves as a reusable decision component whose functionality varies with the surrounding workflow. Meanwhile, public attention is concentrated in routing and interface agents and does not track project counts. Our findings provide a quantitative view of Jev's emerging ecosystem and inform the design and evaluation of general-purpose decision models across diverse application contexts.
papers.abstract_zh: Jev 是一种快速、低成本的决策模型，能够通过选项、二元判断和评分来回答自然语言问题。随着其公共生态系统的快速增长，Jev 在各类应用中的使用方式，以及公众关注度与项目分布之间的关系尚不明确。为了回答这些问题，我们对截至 2026 年 9 月 22 日从 GitHub 上收集的 2,170 个公开 Jev 项目进行了大规模的数据驱动分析。我们发现 Jev 的公共生态系统在早期呈现出快速增长态势，不仅有新项目的涌现，还被集成到现有的代码库中。在不同领域中，各类项目利用 Jev 实现多种决策目标，并组合使用其接口。属性判断和评分功能被广泛应用，而动作选择、内容过滤以及模型和工具选择的使用则因领域而异。这些模式表明，Jev 充当了一种可复用的决策组件，其功能随周边工作流的变化而调整。与此同时，公众的关注点集中在路由和接口智能体上，并未完全与项目数量的增长保持一致。我们的研究结果为 Jev 的新兴生态系统提供了量化视角，并为跨不同应用场景的通用决策模型的设计与评估提供了参考。

0ny1SNXqYxE.video_title: Targeting Pivotal Decisions for Credit Assignment in Agentic Reinforcement Learning (Sep 2026)

papers.title: Targeting Pivotal Decisions for Credit Assignment in Agentic Reinforcement Learning (Sep 2026)
papers.abstract: Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) has become a promising approach for training large language model agents. However, its uniform assignment of trajectory-level advantages to all policy tokens fails to distinguish consequential decisions from less relevant ones, obscuring which intermediate decisions contributed to success. We introduce ProVer, a framework that targets potentially pivotal decisions for fine-grained credit assignment in agentic reinforcement learning. Given a rollout group, an agentic judge contrasts successful and failed trajectories to propose a segment potentially responsible for their divergent outcomes. Rather than directly trusting the judge's assessment, ProVer verifies the proposed segment by estimating its advantage from the difference in terminal success rates between current-policy continuations sampled before and after the segment. Positive estimates are then incorporated into the GRPO advantages of policy tokens within the proposed segment. By using model judgment only to select where to verify, ProVer grounds local credit in observed outcomes without exhaustively evaluating every intermediate state. Across ALFWorld, WebShop, and SearchQA, ProVer achieves the strongest average performance at both model scales, with relative improvements over GRPO of 9.91% and 7.12% for Qwen3.5-2B and Qwen3.5-4B, respectively. Further analyses demonstrate that informed segment selection improves policy training with modest additional generation overhead, even without a frontier-scale judge model, highlighting the effectiveness and efficiency of selectively targeting pivotal decisions for fine-grained credit assignment in agentic reinforcement learning.
papers.abstract_zh: 组相对策略优化（GRPO）已成为训练大语言模型智能体的一种极具前景的方法。然而，它将轨迹级别的优势统一分配给所有策略词元，未能区分关键决策与次要决策，从而掩盖了哪些中间决策对成功做出了贡献。我们引入了 ProVer，这是一种旨在定位潜在关键决策，以实现智能体强化学习中细粒度信用分配的框架。给定一个展开组（rollout group），智能体评判器会对比成功和失败的轨迹，以提出可能导致其结果差异的片段。ProVer 并不直接信任评判器的评估，而是通过估计该片段前后采样的当前策略延续在最终成功率上的差异，来验证所提出的片段。随后，正向估计值会被纳入该片段内策略词元的 GRPO 优势中。通过仅利用模型判断来选择验证位置，ProVer 将局部信用归因于观察到的结果，而无需详尽评估每一个中间状态。在 ALFWorld、WebShop 和 SearchQA 测试中，ProVer 在两种模型规模下均实现了最强的平均性能，相比 GRPO，Qwen3.5-2B 和 Qwen3.5-4B 的相对提升分别为 9.91% 和 7.12%。进一步分析表明，即使没有前沿规模的评判模型，基于信息的片段选择也能在仅增加少量生成开销的情况下改善策略训练，这凸显了在智能体强化学习中选择性地瞄准关键决策以进行细粒度信用分配的有效性和效率。

1NMmagyDhD8.video_title: How JEPA Works: Predict the Meaning, Not the Pixels

papers.abstract: This paper demonstrates an approach for learning highly semantic image representations without relying on hand-crafted data-augmentations. We introduce the Image-based Joint-Embedding Predictive Architecture (I-JEPA), a non-generative approach for self-supervised learning from images. The idea behind I-JEPA is simple: from a single context block, predict the representations of various target blocks in the same image. A core design choice to guide I-JEPA towards producing semantic representations is the masking strategy; specifically, it is crucial to (a) sample target blocks with sufficiently large scale (semantic), and to (b) use a sufficiently informative (spatially distributed) context block. Empirically, when combined with Vision Transformers, we find I-JEPA to be highly scalable. For instance, we train a ViT-Huge/14 on ImageNet using 16 A100 GPUs in under 72 hours to achieve strong downstream performance across a wide range of tasks, from linear classification to object counting and depth prediction.
papers.abstract_zh: 本文提出了一种无需依赖人工数据增强即可学习高语义图像表征的方法。我们引入了基于图像的联合嵌入预测架构（I-JEPA），这是一种用于图像自监督学习的非生成式方法。I-JEPA背后的思想很简单：从单个上下文块出发，预测同一图像中各个目标块的表征。引导I-JEPA生成语义表征的核心设计选择在于掩码策略；具体而言，关键在于（a）采样具有足够大尺度（语义）的目标块，以及（b）使用信息量足够丰富（空间分布）的上下文块。实验表明，当与视觉Transformer（Vision Transformers）结合时，I-JEPA具有高度的可扩展性。例如，我们在16块A100 GPU上，在不到72小时内完成了ViT-Huge/14在ImageNet上的训练，并在从线性分类到目标计数和深度预测等广泛的下游任务中表现优异。

papers.abstract: This paper explores feature prediction as a stand-alone objective for unsupervised learning from video and introduces V-JEPA, a collection of vision models trained solely using a feature prediction objective, without the use of pretrained image encoders, text, negative examples, reconstruction, or other sources of supervision. The models are trained on 2 million videos collected from public datasets and are evaluated on downstream image and video tasks. Our results show that learning by predicting video features leads to versatile visual representations that perform well on both motion and appearance-based tasks, without adaption of the model's parameters; e.g., using a frozen backbone. Our largest model, a ViT-H/16 trained only on videos, obtains 81.9% on Kinetics-400, 72.2% on Something-Something-v2, and 77.9% on ImageNet1K.
papers.abstract_zh: 本文探讨了将特征预测作为视频无监督学习的独立目标，并介绍了V-JEPA。这是一系列仅通过特征预测目标训练的视觉模型，未使用预训练的图像编码器、文本、负样本、重建或其他监督来源。这些模型在从公开数据集中收集的200万段视频上进行训练，并在下游图像和视频任务上进行评估。实验结果表明，通过预测视频特征进行学习可以获得通用的视觉表征，在无需调整模型参数（如使用冻结的主干网络）的情况下，在基于运动和外观的任务中均表现良好。我们最大的模型ViT-H/16仅通过视频训练，在Kinetics-400上达到81.9%，在Something-Something-v2上达到72.2%，在ImageNet1K上达到77.9%。

papers.abstract: A major challenge for modern AI is to learn to understand the world and learn to act largely by observation. This paper explores a self-supervised approach that combines internet-scale video data with a small amount of interaction data (robot trajectories), to develop models capable of understanding, predicting, and planning in the physical world. We first pre-train an action-free joint-embedding-predictive architecture, V-JEPA 2, on a video and image dataset comprising over 1 million hours of internet video. V-JEPA 2 achieves strong performance on motion understanding (77.3 top-1 accuracy on Something-Something v2) and state-of-the-art performance on human action anticipation (39.7 recall-at-5 on Epic-Kitchens-100) surpassing previous task-specific models. Additionally, after aligning V-JEPA 2 with a large language model, we demonstrate state-of-the-art performance on multiple video question-answering tasks at the 8 billion parameter scale (e.g., 84.0 on PerceptionTest, 76.9 on TempCompass). Finally, we show how self-supervised learning can be applied to robotic planning tasks by post-training a latent action-conditioned world model, V-JEPA 2-AC, using less than 62 hours of unlabeled robot videos from the Droid dataset. We deploy V-JEPA 2-AC zero-shot on Franka arms in two different labs and enable picking and placing of objects using planning with image goals. Notably, this is achieved without collecting any data from the robots in these environments, and without any task-specific training or reward. This work demonstrates how self-supervised learning from web-scale data and a small amount of robot interaction data can yield a world model capable of planning in the physical world.
papers.abstract_zh: 现代人工智能面临的一个重大挑战是学会理解世界，并主要通过观察来学习行动。本文探索了一种自监督学习方法，该方法结合了互联网规模的视频数据和少量的交互数据（机器人轨迹），旨在开发能够在物理世界中进行理解、预测和规划的模型。我们首先在包含超过100万小时互联网视频的图像和视频数据集上预训练了一个无动作的联合嵌入预测架构——V-JEPA 2。V-JEPA 2在运动理解方面表现出色（在Something-Something v2上达到77.3的top-1准确率），在人类动作预测方面达到了最先进的水平（在Epic-Kitchens-100上达到39.7的recall-at-5），超越了以往特定任务的模型。此外，在将V-JEPA 2与大语言模型对齐后，我们在80亿参数规模下在多个视频问答任务上展示了最先进的性能（例如，在PerceptionTest上达到84.0，在TempCompass上达到76.9）。最后，我们展示了如何通过使用来自Droid数据集的不到62小时的无标签机器人视频，对潜在动作条件下的世界模型V-JEPA 2-AC进行后训练，从而将自监督学习应用于机器人规划任务。我们将V-JEPA 2-AC以零样本方式部署在两个不同实验室的Franka机械臂上，实现了利用图像目标规划进行物体的抓取和放置。值得注意的是，这一成果的实现无需在这些环境中收集任何机器人数据，也无需任何特定任务的训练或奖励。这项工作证明了通过互联网规模数据和少量机器人交互数据进行自监督学习，可以产出一个能够在物理世界中进行规划的世界模型。

papers.title: Trust the Critic More (Sep 2026)
papers.abstract: Standard language model RL algorithms credit every token of a long rollout with the same advantage determined by the terminal reward. Actor-critic methods can provide finer-grained credit assignment, but learned critics are generally considered too inaccurate to trust when training LLMs with RL. In recent works, even when a critic is present, it is used only for baseline estimation, so every trajectory must be rolled out to its terminal reward. We introduce Actor-Critic with Action Chunking (AC2) that removes the need to roll every trajectory to completion. AC2 instead assigns credit to action chunks: short continuations of prefixes of past trajectories. A learned critic scores the state reached at the end of each action chunk, allowing the policy to update without observing a terminal reward. We make critic-based credit assignment reliable through three design choices. First, we introduce local readiness which uses critic-based updates on a problem only when the critic is sufficiently accurate on that particular problem. Second, when available, we provide the critic with a reference solution from a previous successful rollout. Third, we assign credit over action chunks of 10k tokens rather than individual tokens, giving the critic a more meaningful portion of the trajectory to evaluate. We train Qwen3-4B on FineProofs-RL using AC2 and evaluate on IMO-ProofBench. AC2 exceeds GRPO's peak validation score of 18.5% using 2.5x fewer decoding FLOPs. This gain comes from two sources, (1) AC2 requires 25% fewer training steps to reach this score, and (2) each step generates fewer tokens because the policy does not need to continue every trajectory to completion. Conceptually, we demonstrate that we can remove the need to roll out every trajectory to completion, opening up a large previously unexplored design space for LLM RL algorithms.
